# XL / titan / redo regen prompts — GENERATED by build/gen-xl-regen-sheets.py

Never hand-edit; adjust the overlay (scales/verdicts) and re-run. Paste one fenced
block per generation. Drop each returned PNG anywhere and slice with:

    python3 build/slice-sprites.py <png> --manifest-v2 <sheetId> \
        --manifest-path dev/sprite-manifests/xl-regen-manifest.json --review

Slices OVERWRITE the original sprite slug. A re-cut slug that still carries
verdict:fail stays blocked in the theater until re-ruled in the review tool.
